args: $log=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'miniapp-live-smoke-rev22.log'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $log)){throw 'live log missing'}; $text=Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Raw; $required=@('listeners: 9421=true 62000=true','[frida] attached','action-required=open-or-reload-miniapp','upstream-peer-validated=true','live-cdp-matrix:','correlation-assertions=45','cdp-step=matrix passed=true','cdp-step=link passed=true','cdp-step=interaction passed=true','cdp-coverage=full mode=all acceptance=true','renderer-selection=','port-rebind: port=9421 success=true','port-rebind: port=62000 success=true','target-survives-shutdown=true','ports-released=true','teardown-evidence: forced-fallback=False','teardown-markers=agent-unload,session-detach,device-close,native-runtime-release','smoke-success=true'); foreach($marker in $required){if($text.IndexOf($marker,[StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0){throw ('missing live marker: '+$marker)}}; if($text -match 'smoke-failure=|cdp-step=.*passed=false|smoke-success=false'){throw 'live log contains failure marker'}; $hash=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $log).Hash; Write-Output 'live-log-verified=true'; Write-Output ('live-log-sha256=' + $hash); Write-Output 'live-cdp-matrix=Runtime,Debugger,Page,DOM,Network,Console,Performance'; Write-Output 'live-reconnect=passed'; Write-Output 'live-teardown=passed'; exit 0
